# Troffo Component Intelligence

Troffo is a local React component registry designed for both humans and AI agents.

## Machine-readable entry point

- /registry.json — complete structured contracts
- /llms.txt — this index

## Usage rules

1. Select components by semantic fit using useWhen and avoidWhen.
2. Import only entries whose status is "local".
3. Preserve source attribution and license notices.
4. Entries marked "restricted" are external indexes only; request user-supplied licensed source before implementation.

## Sources

- Troffo Core: local://troffo — Troffo — Local project
- Beautiful AI: https://beautiful-ui-five.vercel.app/ — Beautiful UI — Local study reference
- AlignUI · MIT: https://www.alignui.com/ — Doğukan Çavuş — MIT
- Liquid Metal · MIT: https://metal.jakubantalik.com/ — Jakub Antalik — MIT
- Border Beam · MIT: https://beam.jakubantalik.com/ — Jakub Antalik — MIT
- Thinking Orbs · MIT: https://orbs.jakubantalik.com/ — Jakub Antalik & Alex Brinza — MIT
- Transitions.dev · Free: https://transitions.dev/ — Jakub Antalik — Transitions.dev snippet license
- Transitions.dev · Pro: https://transitions.dev/pro.html — Jakub Antalik — Restricted / purchase required
